title.narrative: Pacific NDC Hub - Phase III

description.narrative: GGGI is a delivery partner of the Pacific NDC Hub. The NDC Hub supports Pacific Island Countries (PICs) to enhance and successfully implement their NDCs. Phase III of this project will see GGGI continue to support PICs to enhance NDC ambitions and implement NDC roadmaps and invesment plans. - The first phase of the Pacific NDC Hub started in October 2019 and ended in March 2020 (project code: PR1-E1).- The second phase started in April 2020 and will end in November 2021 (this project code: PAC06).
